name: reference_date
description: The as-of date for the features; the label window is the 60 days after it.

name: days_since_last_booking
description: Days from the most recent confirmed booking to reference_date; NULL if never booked.

name: sessions_last_90d
description: Signed-in sessions in the 90 days before reference_date.

name: warm_views_last_90d
description: Sessions with a warm-escape view in the 90 days before reference_date.

name: ltv_band
description: none, low, mid, high or vip, computed on lifetime value before reference_date.

name: booked_warm_escape_60d
description: Label: 1 if the customer made a confirmed warm-escape booking in the 60 days after reference_date, else 0.
